question: On actual frozen physical density fields, what fraction of a synchronized state solve lies in complete constrained products, and is there a measured premise for a separate fully charged modal8 campaign?
scope: Prospective warm prepared-state diagnostic; unchanged donor PCG and FP64 kernels. The earlier fully charged protocol is not executed or amended.

measurement.plain: Synchronized host timer includes rebuilding/transferring modulus, constructing the common Jacobi diagonal, unmodified zero-start PCG with native true checks, and transfer of the accepted state to host.
measurement.profile: Same timer and operations; preallocated CUDA event pair around every complete constrained product, no per-product synchronizations. Sum intervals after solve synchronization. Persist every event interval and call count.
measurement.warmup: One capped PCG solve per case/path compiles solver operations; save and independently check each rejected state. Thermal preamble runs modal products for 20 seconds on the first large case.
measurement.overhead: Profiled solve / median of three plain solves minus one; attributable only if iterations and calls match every plain replicate. Absolute overhead must be <=5% on every primary path.
measurement.excluded: Process/context imports, geometry/kernel preparation, capped warmups, event allocation, C++ auditing and archive I/O. Record these separately. Thus this is not the earlier charged-episode gate.
measurement.reference: First plain fused_ai_fp64 solution by replicate for each case; compare all states as well as independent physical checks.

planning_gate: All normal states and cross-path checks pass; complete declared data; every primary path has qualified profiling (matched work, <=5% absolute apparent overhead); candidate median plain solve ratio >=1.10 against every baseline at both primary sizes. This only justifies a separately executed fully charged campaign, not publication or a speedup claim.
on_failure: Retain complete and partial records. Stop on physical failure, timeout or cap; do not replace the rental or relax thresholds within this diagnostic.

documentation.use: CUDA event timing, synchronization, compilation and context overhead scope; documentation only, not a screened paper.
